title: Products
subtitle: Manage the products and services available in this store.
noBusinessDesc: You need to create or select a business before managing products.
noStoreDesc: Select a store to manage products.
noProductsDesc: Add your first product to get started.
deleteMessage: This will permanently remove the product from the store.
inUseMessage: {name} is referenced elsewhere and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead? Inactive products stay linked to existing references but won't appear in new pickers.
detachConfirmMessage: Remove the tag '{tag}' from '{product}'? This won't delete the tag itself.
toggleDeactivateMessage: Are you sure you want to deactivate '{name}'? Existing references stay, but it won't appear in new pickers.
toggleReactivateMessage: Are you sure you want to reactivate '{name}'?
bulkTagsSuccess: Tags added to the selected products.
categoryLocked: Category cannot be changed once a product has a code.
codeAutoHint: The product code is auto-generated from the category prefix (e.g. SV000001).
inactiveHint: Inactive products won't appear in pickers for new transactions.
nameTooLong: Product name must be at most 255 characters.
duplicateName: A product with this name already exists: {name}. Open it from the suggestion list above to edit.

import.category: Category is matched by its code or its full name; create a missing category right from the preview.
import.name: Name is the product name and must be unique within this store.
import.unit: Unit is matched by name; create a missing unit from the preview.
import.tags: Tags are optional: list them as "Key: Value" separated by commas. A key with no value attaches the tag itself.
import.unknownTags: Unknown tags or tag values can be created right from the preview before importing.
